status: research target, not an achieved result
equations: 3D full compressible ideal-gas Euler, gamma=2, all five conserved variables
initial_density_family: Any C1 function rho0:R^3->R with 1<=rho0<=2 and Lipschitz constant <=L in the coordinate maximum norm; L>=1. Density depends freely on all three coordinates.
boundary_condition: Material impermeable boundary prescribed by F_t; fluid normal velocity equals the moving boundary's normal velocity. No periodic or free-vacuum boundary claim.
time: Prescribed T in [0,1]; investigate the same formulas for longer finite times but do not rely on this extension for the target.
candidate_algorithm: Sample rho0 at centers of a uniform material grid, retain a piecewise-constant material density, and reconstruct velocity and energy with the exact material flow map. Include spatial representation error in a uniform full-state norm.
accuracy: Uniform maximum absolute error among the five nondimensional conservative components over the entire moving domain, not merely grid point or cell-average error; target epsilon>0.
algorithm_class: Deterministic adaptive point-query algorithms with access to initial density only through point evaluations and known class parameters. No density formula, derivatives, integral queries, training data, or input-specific precomputation. Arbitrary postprocessing/output representations allowed for the information lower bound.
cost_model: Point-oracle queries and scalar arithmetic/storage operations; unit-cost exact-real/oracle model. Give a separate approximation-oracle budget if possible. No IEEE, bit-complexity, GPU or best-constant claim.
desired_upper_bound: Construct an admissible approximation with proved full-state error <=epsilon using O((L/epsilon)^3) work, including all samples and representation data.
desired_lower_bound: Prove Omega((L/epsilon)^3) worst-case density-query work for every permitted algorithm, by indistinguishable smooth local perturbations. Discharge smoothness/Lipschitz/admissibility of the hard inputs, not assume their existence without proof.
success: An end-to-end Lean-checked Euler solution, accuracy guarantee and matching upper/lower scaling for this family. Conditional numerical stability lemmas, cache counts, or benchmark rankings do not satisfy this target.
limits: This is a nontrivial but special pressure-uniform affine-shear Euler family. It excludes shocks and pressure-driven dynamics; do not call it general 3D Euler optimality. Optimal-recovery lower bounds and affine Euler solutions have prior literature; novelty is not presumed.
failure_policy: Keep the original contract and record unresolved proof obligations at the deadline. A narrower partial result must be explicitly labeled and must not be called completion of the goal.
